signs.d: Pain, pressure or tightness in the chest, or spreading to arm, jaw or back.
Struggling to breathe at rest or unable to speak full sentences.
Passing out, or nearly passing out, especially with chest pain or palpitations.
Face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, sudden confusion, vision loss or severe headache. Note the time symptoms began.
Racing or irregular heartbeat together with dizziness, chest pain, breathlessness or fainting.
